newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Cricket-Cash-strapped Kenya cancel Australia tour.
newsitem.headline: Cricket-Cash-strapped Kenya cancel Australia tour.

text.p: Kenya have cancelled a three-week tour to Australia in December and January because of a lack of funds, the Australian Cricket Board (ACB) said on Friday.
The Kenyans, who stunned cricket followers at this year's World Cup by thrashing former champions West Indies by 73 runs, were due to arrive in Australia on December 29.

"The problem is purely one of finance. They cannot raise the finance to pay for the tour. It is an unfortunate situation, particularly for the players involved," ACB operations manager Richard Watson told Reuters.
Kenya's five-match tour intinerary included fixtures against New South Wales and Victoria second XIs, and the Australian Capital Territory.
Kenya are associate members of the International Cricket Council, the sport's world governing body. Only the nine full members, including Australia and West Indies, are eligible to play test matches.
